MULTICAM RECORDING

Turn any topic into an engaging and natural AI podcast within seconds, using our AI Podcast Generator app. It doesn’t need any microphone, script, or recording experience.

〚 What Is AI Podcast Generator? 〛
AI Podcast Generator is an online app that uses advanced AI technology to generate realistic, compelling, and tailored podcasts. It lets you create podcasts for 1 person, 2 people, or 3 people, with the option to choose different AI voices. Whether you need educational, interview, storytelling, talk show, or news, our podcast-making app is helpful.

〚 How to Use AI Podcast Maker? 〛
Our AI podcast creator app is quite easy to use for all; there’s no need to have any prior experience. Just follow these steps;
Simply enter the topic or script around which you want to generate an AI podcast.
Choose the desired language and how many people you want in the Podcast.
Select the “Content Type” and “Duration” period.
Then, choose the “Voice” and “Accent” type as per your need.
Finally, click the “Generate” button, and the app will instantly generate an AI podcast.

Key Features of the AI Podcast Generator
Below are the main features of our AI podcast creator that make it worthy;

〚 Fast Script Generation 〛
No matter what type of podcast you want to create or how long a script file you upload, our tool will generate results within seconds.

〚 Simple User-Interface 〛
We designed a script & podcast AI maker app, simple for all. Everyone can effortlessly navigate its clean and easy-to-understand interface. Just type the topic, set the necessary settings, and click the Generate button to get the podcast. That’s All.

〚 Easy Share and Download 〛
Once you’ve got the result, our AI podcast generator lets you share it directly anywhere. Additionally, it provides a download option to save the podcast on your device.
Different AI Voices
Our AI podcast maker app offers a wide range of realistic AI voices, so you can choose one that fits your needs.

〚 Multi-Language & Accent Support 〛
The app lets you create podcasts for a global audience. You can create scripts & podcasts in multiple languages. Plus, it lets you choose region-specific accents, giving you full control to personalize the audio voice.

〚 Different Content Types 〛
Another unique feature of the AI podcast generator app is that it offers a wide range of content types, including Educational, News, Interview, and more. For more personalized podcast generation, you can choose the relevant content type.

〚 Adjustable Duration 〛
Before podcast generation, this app lets you choose the custom length of your podcast. For this, it provides different durations such as: 0-1 mins, 1-2 mins, 3-5 mins, 5-10 mins, & 10-15 mins.

There are many more features on the way that we’ll add to the AI podcast generator app. Enjoy effortless AI podcast generation with this fast, effortless, and tiny studio.

- For You Smart Feed: A daily, hyper-personalized audio stream generated on-demand just for you.

record.description_evidence:
Type a topic, drop in a PDF or Word file, or snap a photo of your notes — Slaidio turns it into a finished presentation in about a minute. Real slides with photos, charts and speaker notes, ready to present or export to PowerPoint (PPTX) and PDF.

Write "The Solar System for 6th grade", add your lecture as a PDF or Word document, or photograph a page of handwritten notes. Slaidio plans the deck, writes every slide in your language, picks a style that fits the content and finds a real photo for each slide. Your first presentation is free.

MADE FOR SCHOOL, CLASS AND WORK
• Students: book reports, science projects, history presentations, homework
• Teachers: lesson slides with goals, a glossary, quizzes and answers
• University: seminar talks, research summaries, thesis defense
• Work: reports, pitch decks and team updates with real charts

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Start from a topic, a PDF, Word (.docx) or text file, or a photo of your notes
• 52 styles: 13 designs in 4 palettes each — one tap restyles the whole deck
• 62 ready-made starters for school, teachers, university, work and fun
• 25 slide layouts in every style: covers, lesson goals, timelines, comparisons, glossary, quizzes, big numbers, photo slides
• Real bar, line and donut charts drawn from your numbers
• Speaker notes written for every slide
• Present from your phone with step-by-step builds, notes and a timer
• Tap a slide for a new version, a new photo or a rephrase; add a slide anywhere or make the deck longer
• Export to editable PowerPoint (PPTX): text, photos and charts stay editable. Or export to PDF
• Slides in 30+ languages; the app itself speaks 31

FREE AND PRO
Your first presentation is free: create it, restyle it, present it and save it as a PDF with a small "Made with Slaidio" mark.
Slaidio Pro unlocks unlimited presentations and edits, PDF without the mark and PowerPoint (PPTX) export:
• Pro Yearly — $39.99 a year, starts with a 3-day free trial
• Pro Weekly — $6.99 a week
Just need one deck? "This deck only" — $2.99 once: download the current presentation as PPTX and PDF without the mark, no subscription.
Prices are in US dollars; the price for your country is shown in the app before you pay.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

PRIVACY
Your decks are stored on your device. To write slides, Slaidio sends your topic, the text of files you attach and photos of your notes to a partner AI model — only after you agree. We don't use your data to train models.
